cutoff: January 1 of crop start year; published crop/weather history at least two years old
protocol: Train 1997–2016; validation 2017–2019; unseen final test 2020–2022. Validation historical targets frozen at 2016; test frozen at 2019. No current area, production or target input.
selection_basis: Lowest validation MAE, not test score

unseen_district_test.basis: Deterministic 20% district holdout, selected temporal model parameters fixed; held district crop target history removed
